# archestra_git_plugin (Resource)

Git-sourced plugin package pinned to an explicitly approved immutable commit, with repository tracking and synchronization configuration. Changing approved bytes replaces the package. Periodic checks may stage a candidate; they do not approve new executable content.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Review the exact commit before declaring the approved source bytes.
# A new source SHA or file selection replaces this package; periodic checks
# only stage candidates and never approve new executable content.
resource "archestra_git_plugin" "example" {
  display_name        = "Pinned repository package"
  client_type         = "claude-code"
  supported_platforms = ["posix"]
  source_repo         = "archestra-ai/terraform-provider-archestra"
  source_sha          = "9e6a43f5347f6f3730ffeb75946f6e162791851d"
  source_subdir       = "scripts/integration/fixtures/plugins/synthetic"
  source_exclude      = ["excluded.txt"]
  # Omit github_sync_interval to disable periodic candidate checks.
  # An existing stored credential can be selected with github_pat_id,
  # github_app_config_id or gitlab_token_id; the latter uses source_provider="gitlab".
  enabled = false
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `client_type` (String) Immutable target client format.
- `display_name` (String) Plugin display name.
- `source_exclude` (List of String) Ordered exclusion patterns applied to approved source bytes; changes replace the package.
- `source_repo` (String) Canonical repository path on the selected Git host.
- `source_sha` (String) Explicitly approved immutable commit; changing it replaces the package.
- `supported_platforms` (Set of String) Supported operating-system families.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Package description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the package is enabled; omission preserves the current setting.
- `github_app_config_id` (String) Existing stored Git credential reference; omission clears this authentication method.
- `github_pat_id` (String) Existing stored Git credential reference; omission clears this authentication method.
- `github_sync_interval` (String) Periodic candidate-check interval; omission disables scheduled checks.
- `github_sync_ref` (String) Branch or tag tracked for candidate updates; omission tracks the default branch.
- `gitlab_token_id` (String) Existing stored Git credential reference; omission clears this authentication method.
- `icon` (String) Emoji or base64 image URL; omission clears the override.
- `initial_grants` (Attributes Set) Direct grants applied atomically when the object is created; changes require replacement, and later permission changes belong to archestra_resource_permission_policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initial_grants))
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Credential labels; an empty set clears them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `source_provider` (String) Source Git provider, matching any selected stored credential.
- `source_subdir` (String) Canonical safe relative subtree, or empty for the repository root.

### Read-Only

- `approved_at` (String) Observed approved at.
- `approved_by` (String) Observed approved by.
- `approved_content_hash` (String) Observed approved content hash.
- `author_id` (String) Observed author id.
- `content_hash` (String) Observed content hash.
- `created_at` (String) Observed created at.
- `created_by` (String) createdBy metadata as JSON.
- `created_by_service_account_id` (String) Observed created by service account id.
- `deleted_at` (String) Observed deleted at.
- `file_digests` (Map of String) Observed per-file digests keyed by path.
- `files` (Attributes Map) Observed files from the approved repository commit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `id` (String) Plugin UUID.
- `last_sync_error` (String) Observed last sync error.
- `last_synced_at` (String) Observed last synced at.
- `organization_id` (String) Observed organization id.
- `pending_content_hash` (String) Observed pending content hash.
- `pending_detected_at` (String) Observed pending detected at.
- `pending_source_sha` (String) Observed pending source sha.
- `plugin_slug` (String) Observed plugin slug.
- `scope` (String) Observed scope.
- `source_id` (String) Observed source id.
- `source_kind` (String) Observed source kind.
- `source_marketplace_path` (String) Observed source marketplace path.
- `source_marketplace_plugin_name` (String) Observed source marketplace plugin name.
- `source_marketplace_repo` (String) Observed source marketplace repo.
- `source_origin` (String) Observed source origin.
- `source_ref` (String) Observed source ref.
- `teams` (String) teams metadata as JSON.
- `updated_at` (String) Observed updated at.
- `users` (String) users metadata as JSON.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_git_plugin.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
